text:
ryan.hm: Raising comp-band exception: candidate recommended IC4->IC5. Proposed base $230k, bonus 10%, RSU 0.45%.

 tasha.recruiter: Candidate would like 6/01 start, has two other offers. Needs answer within 24h.

 cecilia.hr: Tagging comp-requests. Need manager rationale, budget confirmation, and director pre-approval. @dave.dir can you comment?

 dave.dir: I can pre-approve escalation if manager commits to 6-month review with success metrics. Finance ack needed. @angela.finance?

 angela.finance: We have budget headroom but policy requires director sign-off + committee review. Finance acknowledges and requests documentation of the calibration plan.

 comp-committee-bot: Request logged. Route: manager->director->finance->committee. Ticket CCQ-2026-2101. SLA 48h. Urgent flag set.

 ryan.hm: Can we fast-track? Candidate timeline tight. Option A: urgent committee review. Option B: provisional offer at IC4 top with $15k one-time hold payment if committee denies.

 tasha.recruiter: Candidate prefers IC5 but will consider provisional if we guarantee start date 6/01. I can get signature on contingent offer.

 dave.dir: I'll contact committee chair for expedited review. Also approve interim $15k hold payment payable after 30 days to secure start if needed.

 cecilia.hr: I'll draft provisional offer text and include clause: "Offer contingent on Compensation Committee approval; if denied, candidate will receive top of IC4 band plus one-time hold payment of $15,000 payable after 30 days."

 angela.finance: Finance ok with hold payment with clawback if candidate doesn't start. Please include clear payment triggers.

 tasha.recruiter: Sending provisional offer now with contingent language, target start 2026-06-01. Will update when candidate signs.

 ryan.hm: Thanks all — please mark urgent and keep me posted.
